name: Shared Agent Policy
description: Injects operator-owned shared and per-agent instruction files into every agent's system context.

uiHints.label: Shared Agent Policy
uiHints.help: Operator-owned instruction files injected into every agent's system context. Use this for rules that must apply Gateway-wide, such as routing responsibilities, identity on shared channels, and authorisation boundaries.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Turn shared policy injection on or off. Disabling stops injection on the next turn; it does not delete any files.

defaults.label: Default policy files
defaults.help: Absolute paths to Markdown files injected for every agent, in order. Example: /mnt/user/HQ/agent-policy/core.md

byAgent.label: Per-agent policy files
byAgent.help: Extra absolute Markdown paths per agent id, appended after the defaults. Use this for role responsibilities and anything containing identifiers that should not reach every agent.

maxFileChars.label: Max characters per file
maxFileChars.help: A policy file larger than this is refused rather than truncated, and the agent is told its policy is incomplete. Keep policy short enough to stay well inside this limit.

maxTotalChars.label: Max characters total
maxTotalChars.help: Combined budget across all policy files for one agent. Files that would exceed it are skipped and reported to the agent rather than silently dropped.
